items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: A guy by the name of Mr. Bill Paisley was the librarian in charge of the library at that time.

ctx.x: He introduced me to his manager, I forget his name. So he says what are you doing, I said, well I'm working around the corner on the street. He said, are you still writing those beautiful arrangements. I said, well I'm still writing, Jerry. He says, well let me tell you, I'm now a conductor for NBC, and he says, I certainly would like for you to write some music for me. I said, well, it would be a pleasure, he says okay meet me up to NBC tomorrow at 9:30 in the morning and we'll take you and see what we can do.…

So I met him the next morning, at 9:30 up at NBC. A guy by the name of Mr. Bill Paisley was the librarian in charge of the library at that time. So they talked to me and signed me up to a contract. Now I'm a staff arranger at NBC. They signed me up to a contract --
